description: Manages SELinux network port type definitions.

parameters.name: ignore_selinux_state
parameters.description: Run independent of selinux runtime state. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: Work with local modifications only. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: ports
parameters.description: Ports or port ranges. Can be a list (since 2.6) or comma separated string.

parameters.name: proto
parameters.description: Protocol for the specified port. Support for dccp and sctp has been added in community.general 12.4.0. Choices: "tcp" "udp" "dccp" "sctp"

parameters.name: reload
parameters.description: Reload SELinux policy after commit. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: setype
parameters.description: SELinux type for the specified port.

examples:
- name: Allow Apache to listen on tcp port 8888
  community.general.seport:
    ports: 8888
    proto: tcp
    setype: http_port_t
    state: present

- name: Allow sshd to listen on tcp port 8991
  community.general.seport:
    ports: 8991
    proto: tcp
    setype: ssh_port_t
    state: present

- name: Allow memcached to listen on tcp ports 10000-10100 and 10112
  community.general.seport:
    ports: 10000-10100,10112
    proto: tcp
    setype: memcache_port_t
    state: present

- name: Allow memcached to listen on tcp ports 10000-10100 and 10112
  community.general.seport:
    ports:
      - 10000-10100
      - 10112
    proto: tcp
    setype: memcache_port_t
    state: present

- name: Remove tcp port 22 local modification if exists
  community.general.seport:
    ports: 22
    protocol: tcp
    setype: ssh_port_t
    state: absent
    local: true
